name: com.natsuneko.modelcontextprotocol.core-framework
description: uMCP is a server implementation of the MCP protocol, designed for working with the AI in Unity. This package is the Core Framework of uMCP. Please install the Management Tools and other packages to use the MCP protocol.

name: com.natsuneko.modelcontextprotocol.management-tools
description: uMCP is a server implementation of the MCP protocol, designed for working with the AI in Unity. This package provides management tools for uMCP. Asset Management, Scene Management, Window Management, and more.
